verified_facts.text: The Saxon Hotel is in the tree-lined Johannesburg suburb of Sandhurst.
verified_facts.excerpt: in the opulent, tree-lined suburb of Sandhurst, lies the enchanting Saxon Hotel

verified_facts.text: The Saxon is set on ten acres of indigenous gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Saxon is situated on ten acres of magnificent indigenous gardens

verified_facts.text: Sandhurst is an area of residences and quiet streets away from the center of busy Sandton.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sandhurst is a mix of swanky residences and quiet streets away from the center of busy Sandton.

verified_facts.text: The property became a hotel in 2000.

verified_facts.text: Nelson Mandela wrote his autobiography at the Saxon.

verified_facts.text: A collection of art and photos throughout the hotel details important periods of Nelson Mandela's life.

verified_facts.text: The Nelson Mandela Platinum Suite is entered via a glass-enclosed elevator.

verified_facts.text: Guests can stay in suites in the main hotel or in the more private Villa suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: As a guest of the Saxon you may choose to stay in one of the luxuriously elegant suites in the main Hotel, or you may prefer the exclusivity of the more private Villa suites.

verified_facts.text: The Saxon Villas are in the gardens next to the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the peaceful gardens adjacent to the Saxon Hotel, the Saxon Villas are our exclusive boutique offering.

verified_facts.text: The villas can be booked as individual rooms or as entire units.
verified_facts.excerpt: These can be booked as individual rooms or entire units for large groups or those who want maximum privacy.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suites are decorated in a contemporary African style with stone cladding and light and dark woods.
verified_facts.excerpt: The palatial Presidential Suites are decorated in a contemporary African style, incorporating natural textures such as stone cladding and light and dark woods.

verified_facts.text: Open-plan bathrooms have dual vanities, soaking tubs and separate showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open-plan baths are bright with dual vanities, soaking tubs, and separate showers.
